F.name: C light + A dark, cosmic background
F.note: Light theme from option C, dark theme from option A. An even, faded cosmic wash behind the workspace; a blended cosmic glow on the login screen; a round, glassy orb for live voice.

light.cosmos: radial-gradient(60% 60% at 30% 30%, #8fb4ffb0, transparent 72%), radial-gradient(55% 55% at 72% 38%, #b9a8ff90, transparent 72%), radial-gradient(60% 55% at 55% 78%, #ffb8dc80, transparent 72%), radial-gradient(50% 50% at 20% 80%, #9fe8e070, transparent 72%)

dark.glow: radial-gradient(70% 55% at 50% 40%, #5b8cff26, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(45% 40% at 80% 15%, #3fd0c016, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(40% 40% at 15% 88%, #8f9bff18, transparent 70%)
dark.cosmos: radial-gradient(60% 60% at 30% 30%, #2f5fe078, transparent 72%), radial-gradient(55% 55% at 72% 38%, #6a55d860, transparent 72%), radial-gradient(60% 55% at 55% 78%, #c0489050, transparent 72%), radial-gradient(50% 50% at 20% 80%, #1fa8a040, transparent 72%)
